A real Native SQL permission fixture has a successful CREDIT quote. While its settlement demonstrably waits on the exact FG advisory holder, another committed session revokes sales.return.post. Rolled-back return/cohort IDs do not exist, original source/payment/journals remain intact and the complete exact money/date/stock/HPP oracle passes.

On the disposable race copy only, terminate the known holder backend after a full uncommitted settlement and deferred closure while the same UUID demonstrably waits. The server aborts the old transaction; the waiter commits one lawful settlement. Aborted return/cohort IDs are absent, only one outer/inner request remains, exact original money/date/stock/HPP oracles pass. This is uncommitted backend-loss recovery, not a lost successful HTTP response or whole-server crash.
